@@ -38,10 +38,10 @@
     "`lspEmitKinds` is the sparse set the LSP emits over the floor.",
     "",
     "`operationPosition` on each tag-role kind drives the LSP helper-name painter (`paintOperations` in `editors/lsp/src/tokens.mjs`). Values:",
-    "  * `head` — the tag's first identifier paints as `operation` when the operations catalogue knows it (so `{{lookup x y}}` lights up `lookup`, plain `{{name}}` stays default-coloured).",
-    "  * `always-head` — the tag's first identifier always paints; used for `{{> partial}}` where partial names are user-defined and never in the catalogue.",
-    "  * `any` — head identifier handled by the TextMate grammar as `keyword.control.*`, but subexpression heads (`(helper arg)`) and pipe targets (`x | helper`) inside the body still scan and paint when known.",
-    "  * `none` — never paint (comments, raw-block bodies, set-delim, errors, `{{else}}`/`{{elif}}` keywords — handled elsewhere)."
+    "  * `head` \u2014 the tag's first identifier paints as `operation` when the operations catalogue knows it (so `{{lookup x y}}` lights up `lookup`, plain `{{name}}` stays default-coloured).",
+    "  * `always-head` \u2014 the tag's first identifier always paints; used for `{{> partial}}` where partial names are user-defined and never in the catalogue.",
+    "  * `any` \u2014 head identifier handled by the TextMate grammar as `keyword.control.*`, but subexpression heads (`(helper arg)`) and pipe targets (`x | helper`) inside the body still scan and paint when known.",
+    "  * `none` \u2014 never paint (comments, raw-block bodies, set-delim, errors, `{{else}}`/`{{elif}}` keywords \u2014 handled elsewhere)."
   ],
   "lspEmitKinds": [
     "keyword",
